name: Captain Titus
unitComposition:
• 1 Captain Titus model
This model is equipped with: 1 Bolt Pistol; 1 Master-crafted Bolter; 1 Master-crafted Chainsword.

abilities.lore: The hardiest warriors refuse to be laid low, even by wounds that should by all rights prove lethal.
abilities.name: Feel No Pain 5+
abilities.rules: This ability always takes the form Feel No Pain X+. Each time a model with this ability would lose a wound, roll one D6: on an X+, that wound is not lost.

abilities.name: Press the Attack
abilities.rules:
This unit’s melee attacks have:
  • [Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/vehicle].
  • Or: If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, [Sustained Hits 1].

abilities.lore: Mighty heroes fight at the forefront of battle.
abilities.name: Leader
abilities.rules: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it. See Attached Units (19)

abilities.name: Righteous Fury (Once per battle, per army)
abilities.rules: In the Fight phase, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit’s melee attacks have +1 S, and when this unit has fought: ▪ This model heals D3 wounds. ▪ Or: If this model destroyed an enemy model this phase, this model heals 2D3 wounds.

abilities.name: Honour of Ultramar
abilities.rules:
In the fight phase, when this model is destroyed, if this unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6:
  • On a 2+, do not remove this model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), this model is removed from the battlefield.

rules.name: Leader
rules.rules:
This model can be attached to the following units:

■ **ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SQUAD**
■ **BLADEGUARD VETERAN SQUAD**
■ **HELLBLASTER SQUAD**
■ **INFERNUS SQUAD**
■ **INTERCESSOR SQUAD**
■ **STERNGUARD VETERAN SQUAD**
■ **VANGUARD VETERAN SQUAD**

abilities.name: ASSAULT
abilities.rules: Units containing one or more models with an [ASSAULT] weapon can shoot using assault shooting (10.05).

abilities.name: HEAVY
abilities.rules:
In your Shooting phase, each time an attack is made with a [HEAVY] weapon, add 1 to the hit roll if all of the following apply to the attacking unit:
  • That unit is unengaged.
  • That unit was not set up on the battlefield this turn.
  • No model in that unit has moved more than 3" this turn.

abilities.name: RAPID FIRE 1
abilities.rules: This ability always takes the form [RAPID FIRE X]. Each time you gather attack dice for a [RAPID FIRE] weapon, add X additional attack dice if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step. Example: If a [RAPID FIRE 1] weapon with an A characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional attack dice for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).

abilities.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS
abilities.rules:
Units containing one or more models with a [CLOSE‑QUARTERS] weapon can shoot using close‑quarters shooting (10.06). When using another shooting type, for each model in that unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE models), you can only select one of the following to make attacks with:
  • One or more of its [CLOSE‑QUARTERS] weapons.
  • One or more of its other ranged weapons.

abilities.name: ANTI-non-MONSTER/VEHICLE 2+
abilities.rules: This ability always takes the form [ANTI‑X Y+]. Each time an attack is made with an [ANTI] weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by X, an unmodified wound roll of Y+ is a critical wound. Example: An attack made with an [ANTI‑VEHICLE 4+] weapon against a VEHICLE unit will result in a critical wound on an unmodified wound roll of 4+, while an attack made with an [ANTI‑PSYKER 2+] weapon against a PSYKER unit will result in a critical wound on an unmodified wound roll of 2+.
